lead.purpose: coordinates a team; shown here, never dispatched as a member

build.purpose: changes the code of a project, with its tests and documentation, in a clone of its own

write.purpose: writes the operational documentation on the documentation branch

test.purpose: writes and repairs tests and reports how the suite behaves

review.purpose: judges a change someone else made and writes a report; read-only

auditor.purpose: checks a diff or a feature in a clone of its own, read-only

advisor.purpose: reviews the lead's synthesized diff (diff stat, task reports, gate verdicts) before sign-off

researcher.purpose: research and design judgment on a hard question; read-only; use only when the lead or the owner names it for the task
